diagnostics.description: Diagnostic output. Changes what is recorded, not what is computed.

sheafAblationLog.description: Append sheaf ablation records to this file. Replaces LEYLINE_SHEAF_ABLATION_LOG.

sessionCorpus.description: The session corpus the session-observation pass reads. `null`: the pass does nothing. Replaces LEYLINE_SESSION_CORPUS.

head.description: How heads are signed and verified.

requireSignature.description: Refuse an unsigned head. Replaces LEYLINE_HEAD_REQUIRE_SIGNATURE.

signingKey.description: The Ed25519 seed that signs heads, as a file holding 64 hex characters. `null`: heads are written unsigned. Replaces LEYLINE_HEAD_SIGNING_KEY.

trustedKeys.description: Ed25519 public key files a head signature is verified against. A set. Replaces LEYLINE_HEAD_TRUSTED_KEYS.

label.description: 1 to 64 characters of ASCII letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`, starting with a letter or digit.

parser.description: What the parser runs, shared by both daemon kinds and read by `parse`, `verify-head` and `rebuild` from `--config`.

queryMatchLimit.description: The tree-sitter query match limit. Replaces LLO_QUERY_MATCH_LIMIT.

queryProgressBudget.description: The query progress budget. Replaces LLO_QUERY_PROGRESS_BUDGET.

trustedQueryHashes.description: BLAKE3 digests of tree-sitter query files the parser may load beyond the compiled set. A set: sorted in the resolved document, a duplicate refused. Replaces LLO_TRUSTED_QUERY_HASHES.

path.description: An absolute path, or one beginning `~/`, which resolves against HOME. No empty, `.` or `..` component and no trailing `/`. UTF-8 without U+0000-U+001F, U+007F-U+009F, U+2028, U+2029, `"` or `\`.

queryHash.description: A BLAKE3 digest of a tree-sitter query file: 64 lowercase hex characters.

secretRef.description: A reference to a secret; never its value (ADR-0049 D4). v1 delivers `file`. `keychain` and `vault` are reserved: a v1 binary refuses them by name (`secret-ref-not-delivered`). Any other key is `unknown-key`; a string, number, array or other object in a secret field is `secret-inlined`.

source.description: The source tree the daemon's store is parsed from. `null` (the default) means none.

language.description: A language filter. `null` detects the language per file.

description: The deployment configuration of `leyline execution-daemon`, and the input of the library entry `leyline_runtime::deployment::resolve_execution_deployment` (ADR-0049 D13). `cas`, `worker.path`, `catalog` and `evidence` are required; every other field states its default. The document configures mechanism and carries no per-run authority: which runs execute is decided per run by the grant. Rules this schema cannot state, and which the parser enforces (README "Rules"): a key twice in one object, a JSON escape in a string, a duplicate set entry, the cross-field rules, and the host checks.

arena.description: The arena is fixed at 64 MiB.

backend.description: The backend this daemon supervises; a grant requiring the other class is refused. Exactly one key. Replaces --backend.

devices.description: Device paths granted to the libkrun worker. A set. Replaces --device.

tsiHijackInet.description: Carry guest TCP sockets over vsock (libkrun TSI). Weakens isolation. Replaces --tsi-hijack-inet.

workspace.description: ADR-0044 read freshness of a workspace share; a share exists only with `source`.

changeWindowMs.description: How long a change keeps a path's timeouts short. Replaces --workspace-change-window-ms.

changedTtlMs.description: Entry and attribute timeout of a recently changed path. Replaces --workspace-changed-ttl-ms.

ttlMs.description: Entry and attribute timeout of a path with no recent change. Replaces --workspace-ttl-ms.

cgroupRoot.description: A delegated cgroup v2 directory each run's cgroup is created in. Linux only (`cgroup-root-linux-only`). `null`: the wall clock only. Replaces --cgroup-root.

cas.description: Where immutable rootfs directories live: an operator directory, or a case-sensitive volume LLO provisions beneath stateDir. Exactly one key. The run root (each run's ephemeral rootfs parent) is neither inside, a parent of, nor equal to the CAS root (`run-root-overlaps-cas-root`).

volume.description: Replaces --cas-volume, --cas-volume-size-cap-gib and --run-root. The CAS root is the volume's: <stateDir>/cas-volume/mnt/cas on macOS, <stateDir>/cas on Linux.

sizeCapGib.description: The logical maximum of a volume LLO creates, in GiB.

catalog.description: The trusted artifact/workspace-to-rootfs catalog document. Replaces --catalog.

enabled.description: Activate or resume the private CDC index over source_blobs. Replaces --cdc.

control.x-leyline-default: arena.path with its extension replaced by .ctrl

evidence.description: The evidence verifier. Required, with no default: a daemon with no verifier could run nothing. Exactly one key.

unverified.description: Metadata-only evidence and unsigned grants, for local fixtures. Loosening. Replaces --allow-unverified-evidence.

store.description: The CAS blob-store directory of DSSE evidence envelopes. Replaces --evidence-store.

trustKeys.description: Ed25519 public key files trusted to sign grants and their evidence. A non-empty set. Replaces --trust-key.

stateDir.description: LLO's state directory, beneath which a CAS volume lives. Replaces LEYLINE_STATE_DIR and the optional value of --cas-volume.
stateDir.x-leyline-default: <XDG_STATE_HOME>/leyline when XDG_STATE_HOME is set and absolute, else <HOME>/.local/state/leyline

path.description: The first-party worker executable: leyline-native-worker, or leyline-krun-worker for backend.microVm. Replaces --worker.

readyTimeoutMs.description: The longest wait for the worker's readiness handshake. A liveness bound, not an authority. Replaces --ready-timeout-ms (whose default was 5000).

runtimeFiles.description: Read-only runtime library and resource paths. A set. Replaces --runtime-file.

title: ExecutionDaemonConfig (config.leyline/v1)
